title: View basic hardware and software information
summary: Display a quick overview of your Mac's hardware (model, CPU, memory) and software (OS version, uptime) directly in the Terminal.

aliases.text: какой у меня процессор на маке

steps.explain: Run system_profiler with specific data types to get a concise report on hardware and software.
steps.expect: A list of hardware details (Model, Chip, Memory) and software details (System Version, Kernel Version, Uptime).
